compiled_state.title: Update write-cycle-ledger.sh to emit schema v1.1.0 (findings tuples + commit_sha)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: Cycle ledger schema extended; the shell writer (existing producer) must emit the new fields so Python reader sees real data in production, not just tests.

## Gap Analysis Origin
This task was created from gap analysis finding (taxonomy: cross_task_interference) on story 45da-5043. Without this, T3's reader sees v1.1.0 schema in tests but production cycles continue producing v1.0.0 ledgers without findings — silently disabling the Jaccard stability halt.

## TDD Requirement
Add a RED test `tests/scripts/test_write_cycle_ledger_v110.sh` asserting:
- Emitted ledger has schema_version="1.1.0"
- Emitted cycle entries include `findings` array (parseable as list of [file, line_range, category] tuples) and `commit_sha` field
- Output ledger is consumable by `cycle_ledger.read_ledger` (Python) without error
- Backward-compat: if input payload omits new fields, writer fills them with empty array / empty string (graceful default)

## Implementation Notes
Update `plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh`:
1. Bump emitted schema_version from "1.0.0" to "1.1.0" in all write paths
2. Accept new `--findings <json>` and `--commit-sha <sha>` flags (or merge into existing --payload JSON)
3. Default --commit-sha to `$(git rev-parse HEAD)` when not specified
4. Default --findings to `[]` when not specified
5. Update `--reconstruct-from-pr` path to parse the extended marker format (delegates to Python reconstruct_from_pr_comments OR maintains shell-side parser — see related task on parser unification)
6. Existing `_flock_write_json` helper unchanged (still atomic, still uses cycle-ledger.lock)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] write-cycle-ledger.sh emits schema_version 1.1.0
  Verify: bash \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh --epic-id test --cycle-num 1 --findings-hash dummy 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; assert json.load(open('\$WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json'))['schema_version'] == '1.1.0'"
- [ ] Emitted cycle has findings array and commit_sha field
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; ledger=json.load(open('\$WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json')); cycle=ledger['cycles'][-1]; assert 'findings' in cycle and 'commit_sha' in cycle"
- [ ] cycle_ledger.read_ledger consumes the emitted file without error
  Verify: python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.cycle_ledger import read_ledger; ledger = read_ledger('\$WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json'); assert ledger['schema_version'] == '1.1.0'"
- [ ] RED test test_write_cycle_ledger_v110.sh exists and passes after implementation
  Verify: test -x \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test_write_cycle_ledger_v110.sh && bash \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test_write_cycle_ledger_v110.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
